title: COMMAND BLESSINGS TODAY!!
text: Lift your hands wherever you are and just give praise to the King of kings and Lord of lords. Come on, give him praise from the depth of your heart. He is worthy. He is worthy of all glory, all honor, and all adoration. Father, we worship you. We magnify your name. You are the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end, and there is none like you in all the earth. Thank you, Lord Jesus. Thank you, Holy Spirit, for showing up tonight. We receive you. We welcome you. Have your way in this place. Now, I want you to settle down because what the Lord is about to minister to you is not just a message. This is not a sermon in the conventional sense of that word. This is a prophetic encounter. This is a divine transaction. When you leave this place tonight, things will have shifted in the realm of the spirit concerning your life. Heaven is attentive right now. The hosts of [music] heaven are standing by. The spirit of the Lord is moving like a mighty rushing wind. And if you are sensitive enough, you will feel it. You will discern it. The atmosphere is charged. Do not take this lightly. Now, let me speak to somebody tonight. I want to talk to you about commanding blessings. Say it with me. Commanding blessings. Not begging for blessings, not hoping for blessings, not waiting passively by the sideline of life hoping that one day something good will find you. No, the word of the Lord says something entirely different. [music] And I want to spend time with you today mining the depths of what it means for a child of God to command blessings. This is a covenant right. This is a kingdom principle. And by the time we are done, you will never relate the same way again. Turn with me to the book of Deuteronomy chapter 28 and we're going to look at verse two. The scripture says, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shall hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God." Now, I need you to pay attention to the language here. The spirit of God is very deliberate with words. He says the blessing shall come on you and overtake you. Not that you will find them, not that you will stumble upon [music] them. they will come, they will pursue, they will overtake. This is the language of the aggressor. This is the language of something that has been set in motion and it will not stop until it locates its target. And God is saying you are the target of his blessings. Now, let us also look at Numbers chapter 23 verse 20. Behold, I have received a commandment to bless and he had blessed and I cannot reverse it. Say this aloud, I cannot be reversed. I cannot be reversed. What God has established over your life, no devil, no circumstance, no economic downturn, no enemy, no witch, no wizard, no family pattern, no ancestral limitation can reverse. Because the one who blessed you is the one who holds all power in heaven and on earth. He commanded the blessing and when God commands something, the universe obeys. But I want you to understand something that many believers have missed for far too long. God has not only positioned himself as the one who commands blessings over you, he has also graced you by covenant and by the anointing to be a person who commands. You are not a passive receiver. You are an active participant in the economy of God. The scripture says in Job 22:28, "Thou shall also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee." Decree. That word in the Hebrew carries the idea of a sovereign authoritative pronouncement. A decree is not a request. A decree is a declaration. A decree is an instruction issued with authority. Now, here is where most believers are losing the battle. You are praying prayers of begging when you are supposed to be issuing decrees of authority. You are saying, "Lord, if it be your will." When the will has already been established in the word. You are asking God to do what he already told you to do. And heaven is waiting for you to rise to the level of authority that has been given to you in Christ Jesus. Let me show you this. Go to Luke chapter 10 verse 19. Behold, I give unto you power, the authority, to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you. The word used there for power in the [music] first instance is exousia. It means delegated authority. The authority that belongs to Jesus has been transferred to you as a believer. When you speak in alignment with heaven, what you say carries the weight of heaven. When you command in the name of Jesus, the name that is above every name, demons tremble, sicknesses bow, poverty yields, lack retreats, doors open. This is not arrogance. This is not presumption. This is covenant reality. Abraham received a blessing, and that blessing was transmitted to Christ, and through Christ it has come to you and to me. Look at what Galatians 3:14 says, that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith. You are not just a sinner saved by grace. You are an heir of Abraham. You are a child of the covenant. The blessing of Abraham, which is comprehensive, which covers spirit, soul, body, relationships, finances, destiny, influence, the blessing of Abraham has come upon you through Christ Jesus. Now, what was the blessing of Abraham? Let me show you. In Genesis 12, God spoke to Abraham and said, "I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you, and make your name great, and you shall be a blessing." In Genesis 24, the scripture makes a very powerful statement. It says, "The Lord had blessed Abraham in all things." Not some things, not certain areas, in all things. God's intention for you as a child of Abraham through faith is comprehensive blessing. Blessing that touches every department of your life, not one area left in lack, not one dimension left in defeat. But, commanding blessings, I want to be very precise here. Commanding blessings is not a name it and claim it gimmick. It is not a confession game where you say words without understanding. Commanding blessings flows from a life that is positioned correctly before God. And this is where I want to spend considerable time because I have seen many people who know the right confessions but are not living the right life. And they wonder why the blessings are not flowing. Let me show you the architecture. Let me show you the structure. The Deuteronomy 28 passage says, "The blessing shall come upon you and overtake you if you hearken onto the voice of the Lord your God." There is a conditional clause. The Hebrew word for hearken there is shamah. And shamah means to hear with the intent to obey. It is not just hearing, it is hearing and doing. It is a posture of complete surrender and alignment to the word and the voice of God. When your life is in alignment with God, the blessing does not need to be chased, it chases you. This is what Psalm 1 is describing. Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that bringeth forth his fruit in his season. His leaf also shall not wither, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. Do you see it? The blessing is not accidental. The blessing is architectural. It is the result of a life that is built on a certain foundation. A life that is connected to the word, connected to the spirit, walking in righteousness, walking in the fear of the Lord. And so, before you can command blessings, there is something you must settle. You must settle the matter of your relationship with God because you cannot command what you do not have access to. You cannot draw from a well you are not connected to. The first thing you must establish is your sonship, your identity in Christ because it is the son who has access to the father's resources. It is the heir who has a right to the inheritance. Many of you tonight, I want to speak to you directly. You have been struggling, you have been striving, you have been working hard, and it feels like for every step forward you take two steps backward. And you have been asking God what is wrong. Let me tell you what the spirit of God is saying. Your struggle is not a sign that God has abandoned you. Your struggle is an invitation to go deeper in God. Because when you go deeper, when you encounter the living God at a new level, something shifts that no external circumstance can unshift. The root grows deeper and the fruit becomes more consistent. [music] Now, let us talk about the mechanics of commanding blessings because this is practical, this is applicable, and I want you to leave tonight not just inspired but equipped. The first dimension of commanding blessings is through the word of God. Romans 10:17 says, "Faith cometh by hearing and hearing by the word of God." When you fill yourself with the word of God concerning covenant blessings, something happens in your spirit. Faith rises, and faith is the currency of the kingdom. Without faith, it is impossible to please God. And it is faith that makes the commands of a believer potent and effective. Let me give you this. Hebrews 11:2-3 says, "Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God." The word frame there in the Greek is katartizo. It means to perfectly complete, to fit together, to arrange. God framed the worlds with his word. He He and it was so. And the principle that God demonstrated in creation is the same principle he gave to his children. Your words, when spoken in faith and in alignment with the word of God, have the power to frame your world. To arrange your circumstances. To shift what has been fixed in the wrong position. This is what Isaiah 55:11 is saying. So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that [music] which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing where to I sent it. The word goes out and it does not come back empty. It performs. It accomplishes. It prospers. When you take the word of God and you speak it over your life, over your family, over your business, over your health, you are releasing something that heaven backs. You are releasing something that cannot fail because God himself [music] is the guarantor. The second dimension of commanding blessings is through prayer. And I want to distinguish between types of prayer. Because not all prayer is equal in function. There is petitionary prayer, where you present your needs before God. There is intercessory prayer, where you stand in the gap for others. There is the prayer of agreement based on Matthew 18:19. There is the prayer of binding and loosing. Based on Matthew 16:19. And there is what I want to call the prayer of prophetic declaration. Where you are not asking God to do something, you are enforcing what God has already said. You are enforcing the verdict of heaven over your situation. When Daniel prayed in Daniel chapter 9, the angel Gabriel came and said, "At the beginning of thy supplications, the commandment came forth." The moment Daniel began to pray, heaven responded. The answer was dispatched immediately. The delay was not from God. The delay was from the prince of the kingdom of Persia, who withstood the angel for 21 days. This tells you something profound. Your blessings are not delayed because God has not approved them. Your blessings may be facing opposition in the realm of the spirit, and prayer is the instrument by which you engage and overcome that opposition. This is why Paul says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." There is a wrestling. There is a contending. There is a warfare dimension to receiving what God has already provided. And the believer who understands this does not give up when the answer does not come immediately. They press in. They persist. They continue to contend in prayer until heaven breaks through, and what has been dispatched in the spirit manifest in the natural. Let me talk to you about another instrument of commanding blessings, and that is praise and worship. Now, I know this sounds like conventional church talk, but I want to show you something that is not conventional. In 2 Chronicles chapter 20, Jehoshaphat faced an army so massive that his military was overwhelmed, and the spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel, and the instruction was remarkable. The instruction was, "Ye shall not need to fight in this battle. Set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the Lord." And then, Jehoshaphat did something that makes no military sense whatsoever. He put the choir in front of the army. He sent the worshipers forward, and the scripture says, "As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set ambushements against the enemy, and the enemy destroyed themselves." Do you see what praise did? Praise activated divine ambushement. Praise released heavenly intervention. Praise moved God into the situation in such a way that what was impossible became effortless. When you praise God, you are not doing a religious exercise. You are engaging one of the most powerful weapons in the kingdom arsenal. Psalm 22:2-3 says, "God inhabits the praises of his people." When you praise, God shows up. And when God shows up, the blessings follow because blessings are not things God sends from a distance. Blessings flow from the presence of God, and praise is the gateway to his presence. Now, I want to talk about the spirit of commanded blessing as distinct from earned or striven for blessing because I think this is where the body of Christ needs a paradigm shift. Many of God's people are still trying to earn their blessings. They are saying, "Lord, I have fasted 14 days. Lord, I have given so much. Lord, I have done this and that." As if God is a businessman who gives bonuses based on performance. And yes, there is a principle of sowing and reaping. There is a principle of covenant faithfulness being rewarded, but the blessing of God is fundamentally a grace gift. It is rooted in who God is, not in what you have done. Ephesians 1:2-3 says, "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who had blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ Jesus." Past tense, already done. Had blessed, not will bless if you qualify. Not will bless if you behave. Had blessed. The blessing is already in your account in the spirit. The work is not to earn the blessing. The work is to access what has already been deposited, and access comes through faith, through alignment, through the anointing of the spirit, through prophetic understanding. This is why Proverbs 10:22 says, "The blessing of the Lord maketh rich, and he added no sorrow with it." Notice, it does not say, "Your effort makes rich." It does not say, "Your qualifications make rich." The blessing of the Lord makes rich. When the blessing of God rests upon a life, things happen that cannot be explained by human logic. Doors open that should not have opened. Connections come that you did not engineer. Resources flow from unexpected directions. Opportunities materialize out of thin air because the blessing of God is a supernatural force that operates beyond the principles of this world system. And I want to talk to somebody who has been trying to work their way into blessing. You have been working harder and harder and harder. And there is nothing wrong with diligence. Proverbs 22:29 says, "Seest thou a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings." But there is a place of grace. There is a place of anointing. Where you enter into a rest in God and you let the blessing flow. You position yourself and you let God be God over your situation. You come to a place where you say, "I have done what I can do in the natural. Now I trust the supernatural to take over." And when the supernatural takes over, it does in one moment what years of striving could not accomplish. This is what happened to Joseph. Joseph went from the pit to the prison to the palace. >> [music] >> And in each phase, the scripture says the Lord was with Joseph. The Lord was with Joseph and he prospered. Not Joseph was so talented that he prospered. Not Joseph was so connected that he prospered. The Lord was with Joseph. The blessing of divine presence resting on a life is the most powerful asset any human being can possess. And that presence is available to you tonight as a born again believer who has surrendered to the lordship of Jesus Christ. Let me give you something about commanding blessings through prophetic alignment. In 1 Kings chapter 17, when the prophet Elijah spoke to the widow of Zarephath, she was in a hopeless situation. She had a handful of meal and a little oil. She was preparing her last meal for herself and her son. And then a man of God shows up and makes what sounds like an outrageous demand, "Give me first. Make me a little cake first and bring it on to me, and after make for thee and for thy son." But then he delivers a prophetic word. "The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth." When she aligned with the prophetic instruction, the miracle became her reality. The key was prophetic alignment. She did not understand it fully, she could not explain it naturally, but she obeyed the prophetic instruction and the blessing became inexhaustible. There is a word, a prophetic instruction and alignment that God is calling you to right now. And your willingness to align, your willingness to obey, your willingness to take the step of faith that God is asking you to take will open a dimension of blessing that your natural resources could never have provided. I want to also speak to you about the blessing of generosity. Because Luke 6:38 [music] says, "Give and it shall be given unto you, good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over shall men give into your bosom." The principle of generosity is one of the most powerful laws in the kingdom of God. When you give, you do not lose. When you sow, you activate a harvest. When you release from your hand what you have, you create space for God to pour in what heaven has. The problem is that many of God's people are holding tightly [music] to what they have in fear, not realizing that their tight grip is the very thing preventing the blessing from flowing. Abraham gave his son. Abraham released Isaac on the altar, and it was at that moment that God swore by himself saying, "Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you." The greatest covenant oath God ever made to Abraham came after the greatest sacrifice Abraham ever offered. There is a connection between your willingness to release and God's willingness to command blessing over your life at a level that overwhelms you. Now, let me begin to move into prophetic declarations because I feel the spirit of God saying there are things that need to be spoken over lives tonight. There are people watching and listening right now who have been in a season of delay, a season where everything seems to be standing still. [music] I want you to know that your season of delay is over. The Lord is saying tonight is the night of your acceleration. What has taken years is going to happen in months. What has taken months is going to happen in weeks. God is about to compress time in your favor. There are those of you who have been praying about finances. You have been asking God concerning provision. You have been wondering whether God has forgotten the desires of your heart. The Lord says, "I have not forgotten you. I have not been silent because I am absent. I have been silent in the natural because I have been working in the supernatural. What I am about to release in your life has required preparation in the realm of the spirit and the preparation is complete. [music] The time of manifestation has come. Get ready for supernatural inflow. Get ready for resources that you did not plan for. Get ready for the God who owns the cattle on a thousand hills to show you that he is more than enough. There are those of you dealing with health challenges, bodies that have been under attack, systems that have been malfunctioning, and you have stood on the word, you have prayed the prayer of faith. You have called for the elders of the church and been anointed with oil. I declare to you tonight that the healing virtue of Jesus Christ is moving through your body right now. By his stripes, you were healed. That is past tense. It is already done. What your body is experiencing is a lie that needs to be confronted with the truth of God's word. And the truth is, he sent his word and healed them. Rise up in faith. Receive your healing. Command health and wholeness to manifest in every cell, every organ, every system of your body. There are those dealing with relational challenges, marriages under pressure, families divided, children who have gone astray. The Lord says tonight is a night of restoration. He is the God who restores the years that the locust has eaten. He is the God who turns the heart of children to their fathers and the heart of fathers to their children. He is the God who heals what is broken [music] and men's what is torn. Receive the ministry of restoration tonight. What the enemy has stolen is being returned with interest. To those of you in business and career, there are doors that have been shut, there are contracts that have been delayed, there are promotions that have been withheld. I decree in the name of Jesus, the God who opens doors that no man can shut is opening your doors tonight. He's opening the door of favor. He's opening the door of connection. He's opening the door of unprecedented opportunity. >> [music] >> And when God opens a door, no devil in hell can close it. No man can withstand the decision of heaven concerning your life. Now, let us go into prayer. And I need you to pray with me. I need you to understand that what we are about to do is not a religious activity. This is warfare. This is intercession. This is the body of Christ rising to the level of authority that Christ paid for with his blood. Lift your hands. Open your mouth. Do not be passive. Do not be a spectator. Press in. Press in. Press in. Father, we come before you in the name that is above every name. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, the King of kings and Lord of lords. And we thank you, Father, because you have blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. We thank you that the blessing of Abraham has come upon us through faith. And tonight, Father, we enforce the blessing. We command it to manifest. Every spirit of lack, every spirit of poverty, every ancestral limitation, every generational pattern of insufficiency, we command you to bow in the name of Jesus. We are not your victims. We are sons and daughters of the living God. We have been redeemed from the curse of the [music] law. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us." We enforce that redemption tonight. We call it into manifestation. Father, we speak to finances right now. We speak to stagnated business and we say, "Flow in the name of Jesus." We speak to blocked channels and we command [music] them to open. We speak to delayed contracts and we say, "Be released now in the name of Jesus." Every [music] satanic hold on money that belongs to us, we break it. We sever it. We command our portion to come to us now in the name of Jesus. We speak to every sickness and disease in the bodies of those listening. Cancer, we command you to bow in the name of Jesus. Diabetes, we command you to bow. Heart disease, kidney disease, liver disease, every corruption of the physical body, we command life and health to flood in in the name of Jesus. Healing virtue of the resurrected Christ, flow now. Flow now. Flow now. We speak to closed doors and we say, "Open in the name of Jesus." We speak to relationships under siege and we declare peace in the name of Jesus. We speak to the minds of those held in confusion and depression and anxiety and we command clarity and soundness to manifest in the name of Jesus. The spirit of God is moving right now. The spirit of God is moving. Father, we thank you for acceleration. We decree that every divine appointment that was diverted is being rerouted right now. Every connection that the enemy disconnected is being reconnected. Every open heaven that was contested is being established. We command blessings to flow like a river, not a trickle, a river. Abundant, consistent, overflowing. We speak to the foundations of our lives. We speak to our destiny. We speak to our purpose. We command alignment with heaven's plan. Let nothing be out of place. Let nothing be delayed that should be on time. Let nothing be diminished that should be full. Let nothing be empty that heaven has called to overflow. We speak to the children. We decree that the children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of the children. No child in this kingdom family shall become a casualty of [music] the enemy. Our children are arrows in the hand of a warrior. They shall go forth and hit their mark. We speak to ministry, to calling, to assignment. Those who have been called and have been questioning whether God is real about what he said. The Lord says, "I am not a man that I should lie. What I have spoken, I will perform. What I have initiated, I will complete. He who began a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. Your calling is not negotiable. Your assignment is sealed in heaven. Rise up and walk in it." Father, we thank you. We thank you for this encounter. We thank you that what has happened in the realm of the spirit tonight will manifest in the natural in the days to come. We receive it. We hold it. We will not let it go. Signs, wonders, and miracles will follow those who believe, and we believe. We believe in the God of the covenant. We believe in the God of the blessing. We believe in the God who commands, and it is so. I decree over every life connected to this word tonight. You are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. Blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out. The Lord shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face. They shall come out against thee one way and flee before thee seven ways. The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses and in all that thou settest thy hand unto. The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure. Things that you have not been able to explain, God is going to give you an explanation of grace. Relationships that you could not manufacture, heaven is going to engineer them for you. I speak to your tomorrow. Your tomorrow is better than your today. Your tomorrow is richer, deeper, fuller, and more fruitful than anything you have ever experienced before. Because the blessing of the Lord is upon your life and it cannot be reversed. It cannot be revoked. It cannot be canceled because the one who said it is the same one who holds all power and his word stands forever. Now, receive it. Do not just hear it, receive it. Open your heart right now like a vessel open to heaven and say, "Lord, I receive the commanded blessing over my life. I receive it by faith." I take hold of it. It is mine by covenant. It is mine by the blood of Jesus. It is mine by the grace of God. And I will not let go of it no matter what I see, no matter what I feel, no matter what the enemy says. Somebody shout hallelujah right where you are. Give God praise for what he has done. Give him glory for what he is doing. Give him adoration for what he is about to do for the best is yet to come. The best is yet to come. You have not seen your best days. Your best days are ahead. The latter glory shall be greater than the former. And the God who has brought you this far will carry you all the way to your expected end. Praise him. Praise him. Praise him. Thank you, Lord Jesus. Thank you, Holy Spirit. Thank you, Father. It is done. It is settled in Jesus mighty and matchless name. Amen and amen.
